metadata.othernotes: Velma is now a solo detective in her mid 30s. She has encountered all Scooby-Doo villains at least once by now and knows everything about them. She has recently been hired to investigate the multiversal phenomenon known as "The Inventory". It's a high stakes gamble to investigate, but she's being paid quite generously for her undercover detective work. Who knows what her curiosity will uncover when playing against her.

case.name: Lost Glasses
case.description: When Velma takes her sweater off, she loses her glasses and is blind throughout her next stage. She only finds her glasses at the start of her forfeit. Until then, she will crawl on the ground and won't swap out any cards.

case.name: No Panties
case.description: When Velma only has her panties and sweater left on, she will choose to remove her panties first. Then throughout her next stage she will attempt to stay covered up with just her sweater on often unsuccessfully.

case.name: Blind Victory
case.description: Velma has won the game while looking for her glasses. Impressive luck!

case.name: Found Glasses
case.description: Velma has finally found her glasses, but she lost a round while looking for them and now has to do the forfeit.

case.name: Found Glasses (First Loser)
case.description: Velma has finally found her glasses, but she lost a round during her search. Which results in her being the first loser of the game. Now she has to do the forfeit.
